topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I opened the door to find a small, wrapped gift on my doorstep, no card attached. My hands trembled slightly as I carried it to the kitchen table, the weight of it making me wonder. It was finely wrapped, the paper a deep blue with silver stars, the bow too perfect, as if it were a memory from a dream. The classroom seemed to blur around me, the faces of my students fading in and out, but one face lingered, that of a former student, now grown, who always sat at the back, always silent. I hesitated, the ribbon almost slipping through my fingers, before I finally untied it, the paper falling away to reveal a beautifully bound book, its pages filled with memories and handwritten notes, each line a testament to the journey we shared. The room spun a little, the air thick with the scent of old paper and new beginnings.
